description: A program running inside the restaurant that talks to the printers. The server cannot reach a thermal printer itself: a browser cannot open a TCP socket, and a cloud bench cannot see the restaurant's LAN (D-084).

fields.description: Where it runs, in words a technician can act on: "Front till PC", "Kitchen mini PC".
fields.label: Title

fields.description: Created automatically. The agent signs in with this user's API key and secret — Frappe's own token auth, so there is no second login to write or to get wrong.
fields.label: User
Credentials Help
fields.options: Use Pair a Device and type the short code into the agent installer on the restaurant's computer — it works once, for ten minutes. Generate Keys is the manual way: the secret is shown once, to copy into the agent's configuration by hand.

fields.description: While a pairing code is outstanding. Empty once it is used or replaced.
fields.label: Pairing Code Expires

fields.description: Last time the agent asked for work. A silent agent is why nothing is printing, and a technician should be able to read that here rather than guess it.
fields.label: Last Seen

fields.description: Tick only on the computer that prints for phones or tablets on the restaurant's network. Untouched, the agent hears this computer alone. Windows asks to allow it through the firewall: allow it on private networks only.
fields.label: Listen on the Network

fields.description: The till page that installed this agent from its menu (D-424). Paper from it is taken whatever address the agent reaches the site at (D-425).
fields.label: Installed From

fields.description: Take the program in Restaurant POS Settings when it changes, at a moment with no paper to print (D-426). Off to keep this computer on its version — to try a new one on another first.
fields.label: Update Automatically

name: POS Print Agent
